version.definition_digest: definition_digest is sha256: followed by lowercase SHA-256 hex of the existing strict canonicalJson UTF-8 encoding of this complete installed public module value. This field states the rule and does not embed a self-referential digest. The original full source identity and the projected product identity are bound separately; matching this module digest does not bind external types, resolved values, schema/API closure or installed package bytes.
version.package_identity: The Core/Read subpaths require exact generated, installed and packed identities and one same-instance Core brand. A route descriptor alone does not establish publication or consumer binding.

precedence.scope: Independent new retained public route only. Existing a10_expand fresh_capture/source-continuity semantics are unchanged. An existing fresh path result cannot be renamed retained. Existing protected operation Read/source lifecycle, original05 paths, and original Host retained-session profile are not weakened or silently rebound.
precedence.whole_proof: Retained whole-origin projections may report the actual original A/C/E/IR proof with origin identity. They are not newly computed observations. This is distinct from a10 fresh partial expansion whose new capture has no whole A/C/IR proof.
precedence.no_upgrade: Catalog proof is metadata_only even when earlier signature/member hashing covered full physical bytes or E. Neither such bytes nor a checked_sections list certifies full domain or reconstructs unretained bodies.

whole_native_origin.whole_asset: Use original asset_closure and original whole index/one-hop target obligations.
whole_native_origin.catalog: Project original full IR catalog and asset_index, no handles. Original whole verification remains origin evidence.
whole_native_origin.exact_selection: One or more existing judgments; normalize catalog order/deduplicate. Union actual original mandatory_closures in original ir.nodes order; discover only original one-hop optional targets of the frozen union, skipping asset as old rule. Do not concatenate closures or recurse optional neighborhoods.
whole_native_origin.expand: Only this route previously delivered/registered handle, same exact snapshot and original Host. Full asset-or-normalized-set anchor plus target mandatory closure in original registry order; no new handles and no recursive optional discovery.

catalog_native_origin.catalog: Repeat the existing full metadata catalog and index. No semantic/body/whole digest upgrade.

scoped_native_origin.all_modes: Recognize genuine same-Core brand only to return origin_scope_insufficient / READ_CORE_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE before grant and Host. This first subarc does not serve even the original scoped closure because complete optional projection/index obligations and body retention are not defined as a reusable immutable IR here. Existing fresh path remains available separately.
scoped_native_origin.evidence: section-fixedpoint returns nodes=ordered requested closure and discards additional complete proof-body nodes; materializeScoped retains only selected mandatory closure mappings and scoped index, not a full canonical IR. checked_sections and stored scope IDs cannot substitute for these body values.
scoped_native_origin.future: No additional local-closure reuse or all-partial overload is implied by this contract.

scope_matrix.protected_or_legacy_or_copied_foreign: Reject before authority; never route a genuine ProtectedPayloadSnapshot through public retention. No credential/ProtectionOperation borrowing, old brand conversion or JSON rebranding.

opaque_and_identity.origin: Only the actual same-Core immutable native snapshot WeakMap object. Its snapshot_id, capture identity, origin verification and admission request digest never change. Inspected data, serialized views, another Core instance, legacy witnesses and ProtectedPayload snapshots do not mint authority. No new snapshot id/capture id is created for reuse. The new operation_id identifies a prepared call only.
opaque_and_identity.request: Strict own-data/closed JSON check and exact candidate tuple admission precede any authority. Keep original unsupported/mixed tuple distinctions, not generic input invalid. One valid request may be reused across separate preparations, with a new operation_id and new consent each time. Normalize selection to the origin catalog order once, preserving caller token unchanged; the prepared view contains the normalized copy/digest. Unknown judgment/asset/version are original selection diagnostics.
opaque_and_identity.preparation: Private token holds original snapshot object, immutable current normalized request and per-call grant. It is neither a snapshot nor a reusable/session permission. Core inspector returns a frozen copy of declared binding data only, not bodies or a mintable token. Read must recognize same Core and consume the prepared token atomically before the first await: available -> reserved -> closed, on success or failure. Reusing or concurrently consuming it rejects; caller can make a fresh preparation with new consent. This single-use call token does not make handles or snapshots single-use. An available preparation is only one pending call, never a session lease or durable permission. Waiting does not waive either actual Host currentness observation or the original trusted embedding session expiry/revocation/disposal. Read synchronously consumes it before its first await, including before Host.observe. Fresh preparation may repeat a legal request only within any still-valid external session; it cannot restart, replace or extend that session original lifetime/counters/deadline. The generic Core/Read primitive introduces no timer, renewable timeout or disposal authority over an independent original Host session.
opaque_and_identity.correlation: origin.admission_request_digest = exact original verification.request_digest; origin.verification_digest hashes the untouched original verification; checked_sections_digest hashes exactly the original checked_sections. Current request_digest hashes normalized new request and never replaces any original receipt request field. Intent, operation_id, original capture and current request all bind each authority and both Host observations.
opaque_and_identity.pair: A private package-boundary bridge may share one actual native preparation with Read. JSON/schema success cannot create that bridge. CJS/ESM must resolve one Core instance; foreign install/control/Host preparation negative cases must be tested.

authority_and_signature.consent: createRetainedSectionReadAuthority is a new native callback token. Original admission grant and a retained snapshot alone do not authorize a later disclosure. Exactly one explicit true callback per prepare authorizes the closed intent for this original snapshot and new normalized request. false/throw/rejected thenable fail capability with no prepared token/Host/body. No credential, broker, physical capture or new materialization occurs.
authority_and_signature.intent: Compute only projection node IDs, descriptor node IDs, target/complete scope IDs from actual retained IR or complete catalog metadata before callback, and disclose those exact scopes. No content values in authority context. Must include all descriptors, declarations, selected mandatory support and all issuable optional handle scopes rather than only selected IDs. Existing rules determine this set; never trim to Host permissions or budget.
authority_and_signature.policy: Current authority policy is safely copied when the authority is made (same original default false/null and lower-hex pin). After grant, inspect the immutable actual original SectionSignatureVerification06. A required signature or nonnull pin must be satisfied by its already verified receipt and actual public_key, never expected claims. A verified_self_key receipt may satisfy a newly chosen matching pin because actual verified key is known; do not relabel/rewrite that original receipt as a new pinned verification. Absent signature under required/pin returns signature_policy_unsatisfied/READ_CORE_INVALID. Present original signature was already actually verified; current optional policy never excuses an invalid original snapshot. No new signature/member/hash algorithm is run.
authority_and_signature.checksums: Original checksum/E evidence is carried unchanged under origin_verification. No completeness upgrade from signature/domain metadata, no checksums reparsing or new E calculation. Retained policy check says only immutable receipt satisfies the new caller policy.
authority_and_signature.failure_order: Native token/input/version and genuine-origin scope checks precede callback. After grant check current signature policy then prepare. Read checks prepared ownership and registered expansion handle before first Host; original projection/Host/scope/budget/transport diagnostic order preserved. Unknown internal exceptions always capability; known original Read errors keep original code/stage/field/subject.

projection_and_proof.values: Use original pure whole projection/selectedContext and actual full IR values/order. For set mandatory union and one-hop optional edges use the same original registry graph and exact full payload-derived records, not stored untrusted claims; no changed author meaning, resource refs, component schema, mandatory condition/incoming edge, selection or interpretation semantics. The native origin already passed those rules; retention does not revalidate or assert new validation.
projection_and_proof.expand: New retained handles use closed retained_section_snapshot binding; do not accept path SectionExpansionHandle06 or old ExpansionHandle as retained authority. Handle scope comes from original whole IR original closure algorithm applied to entire normalized anchor plus target. Discovery uses only frozen initial mandatory set, excludes asset outgoing discovery, and does not grow from proof-only optional targets. Whole anchor is asset; selected anchor is exact normalized SelectionSet06. New expand request ID/budget may differ, selection/asset/anchor/target/scope/origin and actual issued full JSON must match.
projection_and_proof.proof: Every successful envelope keeps same origin snapshot_id and has a separate RetainedSectionVerification06 containing the untouched original WholeVerification06 or CatalogVerification06. New io=[] and new_capture/domain_validation/digest_computation=false explicitly describe this operation, not earlier admission. The original checked_sections/runtime digest/whole digests/IRdigest and checksum/signature observations remain exactly original bytes/values. Retained whole-origin exact/expand can expose actual A/C/E origin digests and full validated capability because origin is a whole proof; they do not claim newly computed hashes. Catalog-origin outputs digests=null and core/interpretation not_evaluated. All action_authorization stays not_evaluated. The field new_digest_computation=false is limited to asset-evidence calculations: no new A/C/E/IR, entry, frame or signature-content digest observation. It does not deny the actual canonical hash computations used solely to bind the current request, intent, original verification and policy.
projection_and_proof.catalog: Only catalog/asset_index metadata body, no handles. Catalog from whole has origin whole proof and ReadyStates; catalog from catalog has metadata-only state and null digests. In both cases status=catalog_only means requested projection, not interpretation downgrade.
projection_and_proof.body_scope: Full envelope/body declaration/catalog/descriptor/reference/relationship and every handle scope must pass both original Host gates. Mandatory unresolved external references reject affected whole/exact/expand with READ_UNRESOLVED_EXTERNAL; catalog follows existing metadata behavior. Never hide mandatory elements, narrow a handle, or omit target information to fit budget or Host scope.
projection_and_proof.immutability: No reread of source path, retained bytes, or file stat, no full-container A recompute, no reconstruct/digest of a serialized view presented as original proof. Mutation/replacement/deletion of original filesystem after native capture cannot rewrite this same snapshot. A new file observation requires the independent fresh-capture route. Revocation/disposal in the embedding may prevent retained disclosure but does not alter captured truth.

host_and_delivery.provider: Read new subpath createTrustedHostReadProvider uses the existing trusted Host private ownership/issuance registry, with the new closed callback observation shape. It does not introduce a parallel Host authority map or accept a raw callback/observation as trusted. Existing old subpaths/typed callbacks unchanged. One bound retained Host provider is reused across reads; another native Host cannot borrow registered handles.
host_and_delivery.observations: Two actual awaited Host observations, before body projection and after projection before handle mint/delivery. Both bind operation_id/request ID/digest/origin all fields/intent_digest/asset/tuple. Preserve original host_id/host_epoch requirements, issued<expires, one-hour observation window, current>=issued/current<expires, scope and denial latch/lift rules. Do not invent monotonicity between the two generic Read Host current_ms values; handles mint at the second valid current_ms. The retained consumer profile independently retains its original clock monotonicity and fixed deadline.
host_and_delivery.handles: Closed JSON full-value copying is allowed; registry authenticates handle_id plus full JCS equality on the same original native Host, origin snapshot and issuance binding. Host epoch, revocation, handle issued/expires and original scope all apply. Handles reusable with a fresh prepared call and current authorization; no cross-origin or cross-route reuse. Expired/foreign/fabricated/modified/undelivered handles reject without registration.
host_and_delivery.delivery: Use original full-result preparation and original trusted delivery confirmation. Registry commit only after deliver returns exactly true and the same prepared call successfully completes; false/throw/nonconfirmation never registers. Reentrant expand inside deliver sees unregistered handle. A prepared call closes on every path. Already observed/transmitted data cannot be recalled and failure must not claim zero physical disclosure. Generic local callback success is not remote delivery proof; Web Host actual server finish plus formal success remains a later consumer gate.
host_and_delivery.profile: engineering.host_retained_session_profile remains byte/value unchanged. Actual consumer adaptation must map its original first admission/pending retention and subsequent reuse to this genuine same-native origin, preserve single snapshot/inflight, original binding/provider, all TTL/count/10MiB input/16MiB view/256handles/1MiB handle charge/1MiB response and finish/dispose rules. No profile integration, HTTP or production session support is claimed by this common API source.

budget_and_errors.budget: Original safe UInt request.budget_bytes and exact full canonical response UTF8 fixed-point measurement including new contract/proof/handles/receipt apply. No body prefix/truncation; insufficient envelope uses original budget rejection and bounded no_body/transport control rules. This contract adds no new max author/input limit or new generic Read timeout. Existing Host/profile deadline and resources remain; originating file capture limits were enforced at admission, not rerun as fresh I/O.
budget_and_errors.read_carriers: RetainedSectionReadCallResult06 has original admission_rejection/no_body_control/transport_failure shells and a new closed retained read_envelope. Missing, foreign or used preparation has no trusted request or independent control budget: preserve the original transport_failure shell with semantic_cause READ_INPUT_INVALID and unavailable correlation. Do not invoke Host, fabricate a request budget, add a controlProvider argument or construct a new admission_rejection for that case. Valid-preparation failures use the current request budget. Old generic controls keep their original correlation meanings, not new proof. Core preparation failures are body-free RetainedSectionFailure06; never misrepresent them as delivered Read envelopes.
